subject.title: Enhancement: Developer experience quick wins from code analysis

question: Where should operators see that an explicit skill command used model-routed prompt rewriting rather than deterministic tool dispatch?
rationale: The routing behavior is documented and intentional, but source and discussion do not establish whether the signal should be always visible, log-only, or opt-in; that visibility level affects normal chat noise and the debugging contract.

options.title: Structured debug diagnostic
options.body: Emit a structured debug-level routing event and document the existing operator command or log surface used to observe it without changing normal replies.

options.title: Always-visible warning
options.body: Show a one-line warning for every model-routed skill invocation, maximizing visibility but adding routine user-facing noise.

options.title: Defer to deterministic activation
options.body: Close this narrow diagnostic request and resolve the routing ambiguity only through the broader behavior decision in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/52473.

recommendation.title: Structured debug diagnostic
recommendation.body: Emit a structured debug-level routing event and document the existing operator command or log surface used to observe it without changing normal replies.

likelyOwner.reason: This person supplied the prior maintainer-context review and is the strongest available routing candidate across the relevant skills and command surfaces.
